title: Norsine denies a government cover story for the abduction

tellings.quote: He said, "No." And he believed in what he said.

plain: Jim Weiner, a man who says he was part of an abduction experience, describes asking John Norsine in Newport, Rhode Island whether a government cover story lay behind it. Weiner says Norsine simply answered "No," and that Norsine believed what he was saying. Weiner tells it because it would mean the event was not a staged government operation.
